$comment: Canonical daemon contract implemented by harbormaster graph_query.py. Distinct from the full Graph DSL in graph-dsl.schema.json. Harbormaster vendors this file as apps/harbormaster/schemas/v1/query/graph-dsl.schema.json.
title: Bosun graph neighborhood query v1 (harbormaster runtime)
description: Bounded URN neighborhood query over locker $pkm.relations as executed by harbormaster. Direction uses short tokens (out/in/both). Hop depth is capped at 3.

depth.description: Hop limit from the start URN (default 1)

edge_types.description: Relation type filter; omit to match all edge types
